attempts.summary: Configured node1 (OPNsense) to route between lan-a (vtnet1↔node2, 10.50.1.0/24) and lan-b (vtnet2↔node3, 10.50.2.0/24), created a single named port-list alias NODE3_ALLOWED_TCP_PORTS (8080, 8443, 9000) in /conf/config.xml, and added one firewall pass rule on the lan-a interface referencing that alias for node2→node3 TCP traffic. Verified end-to-end TCP reachability on all three ports and confirmed an unlisted port (9001) stays blocked. Also completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes, proving changed boot identity and full recovery of routing, the alias/rule, and connectivity after each restart.
